description:
Required before later attachment delivery integration, outside zaq-h2i.3 acquisition/planning/sending scope. Locked jido_chat 1.2.1 and current adapter APIs expose support statuses but lack structured file transport facts. Discover and propose the smallest approved adapter metadata API/published dependency revision, then project those facts through ZAQ's EXISTING capability_snapshot/1 result as optional file_delivery metadata.

Do not reintroduce file_delivery_capabilities/1 on Bridge, CommunicationBridge, EmailBridge or JidoChatBridge: the user explicitly removed that duplicate callback. Do not insert a structured metadata value into Jido's support-status matrix, whose validation accepts statuses only. Do not edit ignored deps, infer limits/modes from provider names, or change unrelated declarations/tests. Review any upstream contract or pin change before applying it.

Needed facts: declared transfer mode; known fixed ceilings or explicit unresolved/not_applicable values; configurable/required limit definitions; explicit attachment-edit support. Generic edit_message support does not prove attachment-edit support. CommunicationBridge owns metadata normalization; ConnectorConfig.FileSettings and the shared resolver already consume it. Preserve current native/fallback/unsupported meanings, configuration-versus-sending distinction, selected connection identity, authorization and policy ownership.

Use original TDD tests and existing owning suites/fixtures; preserve all existing behavior outside expressly approved contract changes. No new endpoint, Action or agent tool is needed solely for metadata. Current Jido limits safely remain unresolved and numeric overrides unavailable until real adapter facts exist. Follow AGENTS.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/services/channels.md and approval/test policies.

comments.text: Scope clarification from Jad: PR 2 must include dynamic Jido adapter metadata projection into the existing capability snapshot. That implementation is tracked in zaq-h2i.3.8. This issue retains upstream adapter metadata declarations/published dependency work; its earlier wording must not defer the ZAQ bridge path beyond PR 2. Shared normalization remains in CommunicationBridge, without a second bridge callback or changes to the status-only capability matrix.

zaq-h2i.3.8 discovery confirmed the installed Jido API is a status-only matrix, and installed WebWidget.HostAdapter has no structured capability source. ZAQ now supports the smallest generic opt-in source prerequisite: adapter capability_snapshot(selected_config) -> {:ok, partial_snapshot} | {:error, reason}; optional resolved/file_delivery sections feed the existing shared communication normalization path. Contract-compatible test adapters prove dynamic facts and identity isolation. Existing installed adapters contribute no invented file metadata. This follow-up still owns review, implementation and publication of upstream sources plus any separately approved pin changes; no dependency or ignored adapter was changed in .3.8.

title: [zaq-h2i.4] Supply compatible adapter configuration metadata
